scene nightsky
It was a normal night at the Miyamura family porn shop.
scene makotodildofight1
And, for some reason, this is what “normal” looked like.
: Makoto! You do not yet realize your importance! You have only begun to discover your power. Join me, and I will complete your training!
: With our combined strength, we can end this destructive conflict and bring order to the galaxy!
: I’ll never join you. Nor will I ever forgive you for butchering the script of Moby Dick but so accurately remembering fight scenes from Star Wars.
: Star Wars is cool! Why should I care about some dude named Ahab when he wouldn’t stand a chance against me — Lord Vader!
: Can the two of you knock it off, please?
scene makotodildofight2
: Production on the Official Dildo Saber has stopped and I only have a few of them left. The last thing I need is either one of you breaking the merchandise.
: Then our sidearms it shall be! To heart, Skywalker! It is here we discover who will win in this fateful final battle of dark vs. light.
: And don’t play with the regular dildos either. I understand that they are toys, but this is not the way they are meant to be used.
scene makotodildofight3
: You’ve said on like a thousand different occasions that sex toys are super versatile and can be used for all sorts of things outside of sex.
: Yes, but combat isn’t one of them.
: I’ve literally been whacked in the face by dildos you’ve thrown at me to get me to stop studying before.
: That never happened.
: One of them almost left a mark. Do you have any idea how embarrassing it would have been to go to school with a penis-shaped bruise on my cheek?
: Yeah. People’d start thinkin’ Makoto’s into all sortsa weird stuff with a bruise like that. Which she definitely ain’t because she’s a good girl and I’m the slut here.
: Give it a rest, Miku. She already knows.
: No she don’t. She don’t know nothin’. Ain’t that right, Maki?
scene makotodildofight4
: You know what? Why don’t the two of you just take the night off?

: Establishments like this require a certain level of maturity in order to be effectively managed and it seems to me like the two of you have no desire to live up to that tonight! I’ll handle restocking alone.
: Maturity? Since when is that word even in your dictionary? You giggled like a schoolgirl just an hour ago when I was talking about the wind blowing.
: Heh. You said “blow.”
: See? You think Miku gets a sense of humor like that from me? Absolutely not.

: You’re right, Makoto. It’s all my fault. All of this is all my fault. Your immaturity. Your depression. Your extracurricular activities. It’s all because of me! Because I make you work in a place like this!
scene makotodildofight5
: So how about I just rip the bandage off once and for all and fire you both? Right now! Effective immediately. Please get out of my store — where you never should have worked in the first place.
scene makotodildofight6
: You can’t fire me. I live here.
: Yeah, and you can’t fire me either. Makoto lives here.
: Makoto lives upstairs. And also the dorms, where she’s free to express her unrivaled maturity in ways that she will inevitably keep secret from me!
: But this part of the building belongs to me. And if I say the two of you are no longer allowed in it, I mean it. Use the back entrance from now on. I’m changing the locks.
scene makotodildofight7
: Wait, you’re actually serious? I thought this was all part of some weird joke.
: Do I sound like I’m joking, Makoto?
: I don’t know. I’ve never heard you sound like this before. This is all so new and scary to me.
: Put the merchandise on the counter and leave. I have work to do and I don’t have any time for your snark.
: I’ll work for free if it’s a money thing! I don’t want the work history on my resume to just be “fired from a porn shop after a few months.”
scene makotodildofight8
: A money th- no! The two of you should have never worked here to begin with! Don’t you get it?!
: Surrounding you with all of this stuff has normalized sex to the point where you’re now putting yourselves and your futures in danger and I can’t live with that anymore!
: This seems like a bit of an overreaction to a dildo fight, but message received. We will put down our weapons and get back to work.
: No, there is no work anymore! I don’t want you here! I can manage the shop myself.
: If you really need a job, I can talk to Haruka about getting you one at the cafe. Now, leave.
scene makotodildofight9
: Fine by me. I never wanted to work here anyway. I was just doing it to help you out because I know you can’t do it alone.
: Well, I want to work here! And just because I met some guy online that I’ve been doin’ the frisky tango with don’t mean it’s your fault, Maki!
: Some girls are just born to be tossed around like a throw pillow and I happen to be one of ‘em! Ya can’t fight fate! But ya can fight loneliness and that’s what we do here!
: Inspiring. Like, really. But I’m your guardian, Miku. And I haven’t really guarded you from anything, have I?
: Ya guarded me from that weird lady who tried gettin’ my phone number last week. Can’t we just call it even there?
scene makotodildofight10
: I don’t think you’re helping, Miku.
: Me neither, but I ain’t got any idea what else I’m supposed to do! I like workin’ here and I ain’t ever been fired before!
: It’s just an impulse. She’ll change her mind the second Valentine’s Day rolls around and she can’t keep up with demand.
: That’s in like half a year! How am I supposed to keep track of the MILF of the month until then?!
: Wow. You really are into this stuff, huh?
scene makotodildofight11

: Yeah! Cause Maki taught me it’s a normal part of life and not somethin’ people should ever feel ashamed of! But now she’s ashamed for teachin’ me that and I don’t know what to believe all of a sudden!
scene makotodildofight12

: I’m sorry, Miku. But all I’ve been doing this whole time is teaching you how to end up with a dead-end job, a husband that’s even more dead, and a daughter who hates you. Just forget all of it, please.
: Hah. Okay. Miku, can you go wait for me outside so I can remind my mom for the millionth time this month that I don’t actually hate her?
: Fine...Can I get one more look at Big Black, though? I ain’t sure if I’ll ever see him again.
: Yes, Miku. You can go say goodbye to the dildo.
: No she can’t. I sold him last night.
: This day just keeps getting worse!
scene makotodildofight13
: So, should I just come out and say how dumb this is or should I let you figure it out all by yourself?
: Mom, you really intend to work like seventy hours a week? You need us.
: The store’s hours can change. And I can hire help of the appropriate age should I actually need it.
: Well, good luck finding anyone willing to accept what you pay the two of us. You’ll be lucky if you even get an application with that.
: Frankly, Makoto, the business is the least of my priorities now when I have two teenage girls running around who see no issue at all spreading their legs for someone old enough to be their father.
: Okay. Well, first off, Sensei would have had to be like my age when he got someone pregnant in order for that to be true. And second, we’re fine. We know how to be safe. You taught us.
: I’m no saint, but I taught you better than this. What would your father think if he were alive right now?
: Please, help. I’m stuck in a space coffin. My family needs me.
scene makotodildofight14
: That’s hilarious, but it’s not the point! The point is you should know better! You know everything! So why would you go out of your way to be with him instead of someone your own age?!
: Oh, I don’t know. Maybe the fact that all of the boys my age are gone? And the fact that I actually really admire Sensei?
: Why?! You’re smarter than him too! This has far surpassed just admiration for a teacher at this point!
: Hey, you admired him for a while too. So you clearly saw something as well.
scene makotodildofight15
: Everything I saw was a lie. Just one big, well-acted facade that deterred me from ever even thinking you were in danger around him. And boy, do I look stupid now.
: I mean, I won’t say you’re not to blame for not picking up on his...preferences sooner. But it’s not like he just wears them on his sleeve to people his age. He’s ashamed of it too.
: Sure didn’t sound like it when I talked to him about it.
: Because he knows that nothing he says will make a difference when you’ve already made up your mind. So why waste the effort?
: You’re not going to wear me down this time, Makoto. I’ve ruined your life enough as-is and I’m not about to turn a blind eye to something like this just because it would make you “happy.”
: Someone needs to say no to you every once in a while or you’re going to turn into a spoiled brat.
: You’re missing a ton of context, Mom. You don’t get it.
scene makotodildofight16
: Context...
: You think context is what will make me okay with my little girl sleeping with someone twice her age before she even graduates high school.
: Better be some crazy context, Makoto.
: You have no fucking idea.
: Do not curse at me either. I’ll have you know I read half a book on motherhood this week and it directly told me to not let you do that and how I should be treated with respect.
: See, the thing about respect at this point to me is that it really just doesn’t matter in any capacity or even circumstance. You’re not on a higher level than me.
: If anything, I’m on a higher level than you since you don’t even know where we are right now.
: Excuse me?
scene makotodildofight17
: In fact, I don’t even know if you’ll remember that I’m sleeping with Sensei a few months from now if I sandwich it in with a bunch of information that needs to be deleted!
: Like, maybe I’m only doing it because we’re caught in a timeloop and I’m bored!
: Maybe I only suck his dick because of the impending apocalypse!
: Maybe I stopped using condoms because I know I can’t exist for long enough inside of one timeline to see a pregnancy through to its unfortunate end!
scene makotodildofight18
: Hell, all three of us could probably have sex together and you’d wake up the next morning not knowing what even happened so long as we’re talking about time the whole way through.
: There are just so many rules you don’t know. Things that wouldn’t make sense in any other universe but are totally fine in this one because this one is broken.
scene makotodildofight19
: So, yes — I have tons of sex with my teacher because time is unlimited and I am immortal.
: And I apologize that this makes you sad, but I am going to continue to have tons of sex with him because time is unlimited and I am immortal.
: Which you can also do, if you want! Since time is unlimited and you are immortal.

: That’s just the way things are here. And I’m not about to be abstinent for the rest of eternity since your feeble mind can not comprehend the nuance of sex in a world where age is literally just a number.
: Now, if you’ll please excuse me, I’m going to go call my boyfriend and see if he wants to put his eternal penis inside of my infinite vagina because, again, TIME IS UNLIMITED AND I AM IMMORTAL.
scene makotodildofight20
: Have you gone fucking insane?
: Why aren’t you repeating your last line of dialogue?
scene makotodildofight21
: Time is unlimited and you are immortal?! Am I a joke to you or do you need anti-psychotics now too?!
: W-W-Why aren’t you repeating your last line of dialogue?! Repeat your last line of dialogue!
scene makotodildofight22
: I’m calling your psychiatrist in the morning. I think your father’s death had a much greater effect on you than we initially believed. Until then, you are not to leave your room.
: Wha...no! Hold on! You weren’t supposed to actually hear any of that! That’s not how this works!
: Makoto...room. Now.
: I...that...
scene makotodildofight23
: I’m gonna go sleep at the dorm tonight!
: Makoto! Don’t you dare defy me! I am your-
scene makotodildofight24
: Hello? What’s-
: We have a code red. I repeat. Code red!
: Finally. Someone’s trapped in a wall and only I can get them out.

: No, you idiot! I just confessed everything about us to my mom because I thought it would feel good to get it off my chest and assumed that including information about the nature of the universe within those statements would be enough to make her instantaneously forget them all, but I was wrong!
: Why did we reserve code red for something that specific?
scene makotodildofight25
: What am I supposed to do now?! How am I supposed to look her in the eye again after telling her I’m going to call you and ask you to put your eternal penis inside of my infinite vagina?!
: Sorry. My what?
: I even mentioned a threesome too! My life is fucking over! Immortality is a curse after all! Why must I shoulder this burden?!
: Makoto, I think the more important thing here is that your mom is an outlier now. This is...a big deal, I think.
: Makoto...can we go to McDonald’s now?
scene makotodildofight26
: Not right now! I’m in the middle of a crisis!
scene makotodildofight27
: So, how are we going to kill her?
: What? We’re not. That’s not why this is a big deal.
: If we kill her, she’ll forget. Right? I mentioned blowjobs too. I said pretty much everything. And now I have to explain all of this to my psychiatrist next, so that’s just great.
: How did this even come up? Did she confront you again or-
: It doesn’t matter how it came up! Just that it did and my plan immediately backfired and now I look crazy because who in their right mind would fucking believe that?!
: Miku’s there too, right? Have you tried doing the same with her?
: No, hold on.
scene makotodildofight28
: Miku! We’re caught in a time paradox and I hate that shirt!
: Makoto...can we go to McDonald’s now?
scene makotodildofight27
: Okay, Miku’s still broken. And by broken, I mean normal.
: So it’s just...Maki who is apparently in on things now?
: In addition to Nodoka and Uta, yes. But-
: Listen...I can’t talk to her. And it’s not like any of the other girls can either, so this one’s going to be on you, Makoto.
scene makotodildofight24

: Were you not listening?! How the fuck am I supposed to face her after saying all of that stuff?! She thinks I’ve gone insane! I can’t have a serious talk with her about anything right now, let alone chronometry!
: I’m sure you’ll figure it out. You know words like “chronometry.” And your mom loves you, believe it or not.
: Not for much longer since her perception of me is now tainted by sexual imagery! Can’t you just get over here and tell her I’m not crazy?
: Yeah. That’d work flawlessly, I’m sure.
: I still think we should kill her and experiment with resets that way.
: Goodnight, Makoto. And good luck.
: Sensei! Don’t you dare defy me! I am your-
scene makotodildofight29
: Sensei?
: Hello?
: Are you still-
scene makotodildofight30
: FUCK!
scene black
: Makoto...can we go to McDonald’s now?
: GO TO MCDONALD’S ALONE! I NEED TO GO BURY MYSELF IN A HOLE!
